card.headline: Not forty goals. The few that matter.
card.body: Pin down the handful of targets that actually decide your year.

alt: Dark card reading: Not forty goals. The few that matter. Step one of the TRACE method.
linkedin:
Forty goals is the same as no goals.

The first step of the TRACE method is Target: pin down the handful of targets that actually decide your year.

A simple test for each goal on your list: if this were the only thing you hit this year, would the year still count? Keep the ones that pass. Park the rest where you can see them, but stop staffing them.

Every roadmap, automation, and meeting after that answers to the few you kept.
